items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: You only had John Kins, Pin Madera and a few guys left. You had a lot of turnover in your band...

ctx.x: Okay. Macho, in the seventies you are losing or you lost a lot of your men from the original band. You only had John Kins, Pin Madera and a few guys left. You had a lot of turnover in your band, you are getting a
lot of young jazz musicians which really enhanced the sound because they brought new ideas. Did you like it that way or would you've rather hold on to the older men.
